description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kohuwala. Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520801
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal status of various land plots in Kohuwala. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, property ownership, and land titles.
